entities.name: Wilson W. Wyatt
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Wilson Watkins Wyatt was an American politician who served as mayor of Louisville, Kentucky, from 1941 to 1945 and as the 43rd lieutenant governor of Kentucky from 1959 to 1963. He was a member of the Democratic Party.
